author: Digital Foundry
description:
We've now split the DF Direct Supporter Q+A section into its own show! Want to get involved? Join the DF Supporter Program, support the team,  join us in our amazing community: https://bit.ly/3jEGjvx

In our second spin-off Q+A show, we tackle the gaping hole in DF Direct Weekly #252 - the gigaton news that Phil Spencer is retiring from Xbox, Sarah Bond is leading and Asha Sharma is in as EVP and CEO. The team share their initial reactions to the next and wonder what happens next. Beyond that, Sony's strategies are under the microscope, there's a focus on PS5 Pro's fortunes when PS6 appears and finally, will the RAM crisis go as far as impacting game design?
